automationNotes: Doc: left-navigation **Developer Hub** icon traceability (**warning)** — automation uses org dashboard DH tile (`use`: orgDashboard). **Basic Information** **Version** dropdown matches `data/dom/Developer-Hub/version-menu.html` (version label, `.version-time-stamp`, creator `.user-info-section`). **Restore** selects the **second** saved version (**Yes, Restore** twice if confirm appears). Requires **≥2** versions and **≥1** Version Logs row after restore. Then **Version Logs** tab/columns, **View** → **Basic Information** preview **App Manifest** in left nav (optional browse doc).
